comment: (C) AN ACTION NOBODY QUEUED GOES WHERE IT IS NEEDED. T3, Dwarven Ruins + a Mountain, hand Lightning Bolt + Skullcrack, opponent at 6; the human queues Skullcrack, then Bolt. The matched plan sacrifices the Ruins for {R}{R} -- an IMPLICIT self-sacrifice mana source the viewer deliberately offers no click for (CheckLine matches it implicitly). The old viewer saw a plan action the queue did not name and fell back to the cast-only pin (and, with a board activation in the line, lost the activation order outright). The "**" pin is sent anyway: TurnSolver::ApplyHumanSequencePin lays the queued casts out in queue order and the implicit sacrifice before the first step (the pre-cast pass), so Skullcrack and Bolt are paid in the human's order for the T3 kill.
